% =====================================================================
%  SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every number quoted in the proposal.
%  The exec summary, glance panel, tables and text all read these macros,
%  so they can never disagree. Replace \dbftbd{...} with the value once
%  the analysis produces it (later: generated by the analysis scripts).
%  Units follow the rules: s, in, oz, lb with 2 decimal places.
% =====================================================================

% --- Aircraft -----------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nSpan{\dbftbd{span}}                 % ft  (rule: <= 6.00)
\newcommand\nWingArea{\dbftbd{S}}                % ft^2
\newcommand\nAR{\dbftbd{AR}}
\newcommand\nEmptyWeight{\dbftbd{W empty}}       % lb
\newcommand\nGrossMtwo{\dbftbd{TOGW M2}}         % lb  (rule: < 55)
\newcommand\nGrossMthree{\dbftbd{TOGW M3}}       % lb
\newcommand\nBatteryWh{\dbftbd{Wh}}              % Wh  (rule: <= 100 total)
\newcommand\nCruise{\dbftbd{V cruise}}           % ft/s
\newcommand\nLapTime{\dbftbd{lap time}}          % s

% --- Sensor / container -------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nSensorWeight{\dbftbd{W sensor}}     % lb (max declared)
\newcommand\nSensorLength{\dbftbd{L sensor}}     % in (rule: >= 6)
\newcommand\nTowLength{\dbftbd{tow length}}      % ft (rule: >= 1.5 x span)
\newcommand\nContainerWeight{\dbftbd{W container}} % lb

% --- Mission targets ----------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nMtwoUnits{\dbftbd{units}}           % container + simulators
\newcommand\nMtwoPayload{\dbftbd{W payload}}     % lb
\newcommand\nMtwoTime{\dbftbd{5-lap time}}       % s
\newcommand\nMthreeLaps{\dbftbd{laps}}
\newcommand\nDropHeight{\dbftbd{h}}              % in (rule: <= 60)

% --- Predicted scores ---------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\sMone{1.00}
\newcommand\sMtwo{\dbftbd{M2}}
\newcommand\sMthree{\dbftbd{M3}}
\newcommand\sGM{\dbftbd{GM}}
\newcommand\sTotal{\dbftbd{total}}               % of 7.50
